files.title: Biallelic Truncating Mutations in ALPK3 Cause Severe Pediatric Cardiomyopathy.
files.actual_scope: Entire actual abstract read: human clinical study of five affected individuals in three families plus myocardial histology and intercalated-disc changes. Full body is unavailable. No direct catalytic activity is established. The linked CommentIn is an editorial, not a correction.

files.title: ALPK3-deficient cardiomyocytes generated from patient-derived induced pluripotent stem cells and mutant human embryonic stem cells display abnormal calcium handling and establish that ALPK3 deficiency underlies familial cardiomyopathy.
files.actual_scope: Entire actual abstract read: patient-derived human iPSC and edited human embryonic stem-cell cardiomyocytes, sarcomere/disc abnormalities, electrophysiology and calcium handling. Full body is unavailable; ALPK3 is not thereby a calcium transporter.

files.title: Pathogenesis of Cardiomyopathy Caused by Variants in ALPK3, an Essential Pseudokinase in the Cardiomyocyte Nucleus and Sarcomere.
files.actual_scope: Actual extracted Methods, relevant Results/Figures and Discussion read: isogenic human hiPSC-CMs with truncations, G1777E/D1784A dual-cleft and D1774A single-cleft variants; cellular phosphoproteomics and HEK293T overexpression support a noncatalytic model within those conditions. Tagged ALPK3 is at M-bands and predominantly nuclear envelope in these models; endogenous antibody specificity is problematic. MYOM2 co-IP is positive in HEK293T, while MYOM1 co-IP is negative despite colocalization. Mouse knockout supplies separate in-vivo structural evidence. Cellular negative phosphoproteomics does not universally disprove a biochemical activity under other conditions.

files.title: ALPK3 Functions as a Pseudokinase.
files.actual_scope: Entire actual experimental research-letter body and Figure 1 caption read, despite its short format/no PubMed abstract: murine ALPK3 domain 1339–1608, murine TRPM7 positive control, heat-inactivated rat H9c2/human hiPSC-CM lysates and radiolabeled ATP; no ALPK3 activity under tested conditions. Mouse K1420R preserves adult cardiac function and SQSTM1 T269/S272 ratio. Modeled nucleotide pockets are not measured binding. This is real negative evidence, not a universal inactivity proof.

files.title: Alpha kinase 3 signaling at the M-band maintains sarcomere integrity and proteostasis in striated muscle.
files.actual_scope: Actual Methods, relevant Results/Figures and Discussion read: human tagged hPSC cardiomyocytes and mouse W1538X models; live tagged localization supports M-band and lacks a detected nuclear signal in that model. Recombinant domain 1577–1828 is expressed in E. coli BL21 and Ni-NTA purified. CM lysates are treated with fluorosulfonylbenzoyladenosine and dialyzed before addition of recombinant domain versus water. The targeted assay uses SQSTM1-HA immunoprecipitated from HEK293FT, active versus heat-denatured domain and lambda-phosphatase controls. These are positive kinase results that must be retained; the target is not a purified two-protein system and T269/S272 antibody does not isolate the residue class. Recombinant-domain species is not assigned merely from the bacterial or human host. Cellular proteomic changes include downstream effects.

files.title: α Protein Kinase 3 Is Essential for Neonatal and Adult Cardiac Function.
files.actual_scope: Actual Methods and relevant Results/Figures read: mouse global knockout, tamoxifen-induced adult cardiac deletion and endogenous C-terminal FLAG-HA knock-in; M-band localization in neonatal/adult cardiomyocytes without detected nuclear localization in that model. HEK293T transfection explicitly uses full-length murine ALPK3 and tagged MuRF1 constructs. Puncta/colocalization and thick-filament protein changes support a proposed proteostasis axis, not isolated enzymatic activity or a demonstrated simultaneous molecular bridge.

files.title: A Novel miniALPK3 Gene Therapy for ALPK3-Associated Cardiomyopathy.
files.actual_scope: Entire actual experimental research-letter body read (machine COMMENT_EDITORIAL type is not used as a scientific verdict): mouse miniAlpk3 internal exon-6 deletion of 1119 bp, endogenous mini model, neonatal cTnT/MyoAAV miniALPK3-FLAG delivery to Alpk3 knockout mice, M-band localization, improved sarcomere markers/survival/function. Primary PubMed Figure caption independently specifies residues 672–1044. The catalytic domain was not deleted. This is not a new human therapy experiment.

files.title: Alpha protein kinase 3 gene therapy restores heart function in mouse and human models of cardiomyopathy.
files.actual_scope: Actual Methods, Results/Figures and Discussion read: human full-length 1705-residue ALPK3 transgene, AAV9/TNNT2 delivery to neonatal or adult mouse W1538X models, and separate AAV6-FLAG rescue in human ALPK3-mutant cardiac monolayers/organoids and TTN-truncation organoids. Human-specific peptides across the transgene and restoration of M-band structure/force are measured. Proteomic normalization is not an intrinsic kinase assay. Cross-study comparisons against miniALPK3 differ in mouse models/capsids/routes and do not prove mechanistic superiority or direct human clinical efficacy.
